{{Quote|We lost Sten, Deadeye, Blunt, and Jark.|Captain Sharp, after the battle against Ventress|<ref name="ISotR 2" />}}
'''Jark''' was the name of a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Devil Dogs]] unit of the [[44th Special Operations Division]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Jark participated in the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]] under the command of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]]. Jark was among the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who accompanied Fisto and Koon in a mission to destroy a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[weather-control station]], but they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] during an engagement with [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Fixer. Jark. Give the Jedi a hand.|Captain Sharp, ordering Fixer and Jark to help the Jedi bury the Khormai|<ref name="ISotR 1" />}}
Jark was the nickname of a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] who,<ref name="ISotR 1" /> like many of their genetic "brothers," was [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and raised on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="databank" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Jark was a member of the [[Devil Dogs]], a special detachment of the Grand Army's [[44th Special Operations Division]], commanded by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]].<ref name="ISotR 1" /> Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Battle of Khorm date" /> Jark was among the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] dispatched to the planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]] to secure the rich deposits of the valuable [[Agrocite/Legends|agrocite]] [[Ore/Legends|mineral]]. However, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] task force led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Tauht]] arrived at its destination, the planet had fallen into the hands of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the Republic was forced to engage the enemy in [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|battle]].<ref name="ISotR 1" />

[[File:Weather-control_station.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The weather-control station, the Jedi's target]]
The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] landed their initial ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]], including Jark and the Devil Dogs, but were unable to bring in reinforcements due to a storm that raged in Khorm's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Nevertheless, the Republic forces were able to capture an [[agrocite processing facility]], establishing a base there. After they were informed by Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wieler]] of a [[Trident (starship)/Legends|Confederate starship]] passing through an opening in the storm, the Jedi realized that the storm was being controlled by a [[weather-control station]] nearby and decided to destroy it. To that end, Koon and Fisto took a detachment of Devil Dogs clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including Jark, and set off on [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop bikes]] to take down the station. After they reached the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] area, the group witnessed a native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] village devastated by the storm. Using their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], the Jedi carved graves for the [[Death/Legends|dead]] Khormai in the [[Water/Legends|ice]]. Devil Dogs [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sharp]] then ordered Jark and fellow trooper [[Fixer (clone trooper)|Fixer]] to help the Jedi bury the Khormai, after which the Republic strike force continued on its way.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

As the group proceeded further, they were ambushed by Confederate [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], who proceeded to fight Koon and Fisto. Meanwhile, several [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] emerged from the snow, and the clones engaged them in battle. Cornered by the two Jedi Masters, Ventress used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|bring down]] an avalanche upon the Republic troops. Ventress then initiated a search for survivors and killed those she could find before leaving the scene. Ultimately, Jark was among the casualties sustained in the fight. Nevertheless, the Jedi&mdash;who had managed to create a [[Protection bubble|Force pocket]] to protect some of the troops buried under the snow&mdash;and what remained of their clone [[Squad/Legends|squad]] successfully destroyed the weather-control station,<ref name="ISotR 2" /> allowing the Republic to win the battle.<ref name="ISotR 3">[[The Clone Wars 9|''The Clone Wars'' 9]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Like all clone troopers, Jark stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="databank" />

==Equipment==
They wore a set of cold assault trooper armor adorned with the red markings of the Devil Dogs.<ref name="ISotR 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jark first appeared in [[The Clone Wars 7|''The Clone Wars'' 7]], a [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] released as part of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic|''In Service of the Republic'']] story arc of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' comic series]]. The issue was written by [[Henry Gilroy]] and [[Steven Melching]], illustrated by [[Scott Hepburn]],<ref name="ISotR 1" /> and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]] on [[July 15]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dark Horse">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-238/Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-7|text=Star Wars: The Clone Wars #7}}</ref>
